newsitem.title: USA: UroCor sees FDA delay for PACIS approval.
newsitem.headline: UroCor sees FDA delay for PACIS approval.

text.p: UroCor Inc on Friday said it expected the U.S. Food and Drug Administation to issue a letter indicating it could not yet approve an establishment license application for the PACIS immunotherapy for bladder cancers.
UroCor said the application was submitted by IAF BioVac Inc, a unit of Canada's BioChem Pharma Inc, which granted UroCor the exclusive U.S. distribution rights for PACIS.
"As a result of the delay in FDA approval of PACIS, the company does not expect to realize any revenues from the marketing of this therapeutic product in 1997," UroCor said in a statement.

Still, the delay will have no effect on UroCor's diagnostics business, which accounts for more than 95 percent of its revenues, the company said. It expects the business to contribute to "a significant increase in revenues and pretax income for the year as compared to 1996."
UroCor said BioVac has told the company that it was confident it could comply with FDA requirements and obtain approval for U.S. marketing of the product in 1998.
